_metadata.description: First managed resolver adapter for AdGuard Home.

requirements.title: AdGuard Home is the first managed resolver backend
requirements.description: The scenario shall expose AdGuard Home setup status, API connectivity, upstream resolver configuration, conservative default filtering state, and resolver health without requiring users to understand the underlying service internals.

validation.notes: Add resolver adapter contract tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-002] using a fake AdGuard Home client for status, upstream config, and health failure mapping.
